title: Detailed Joker Effects 0.3.0-beta.5
body:
Pre-release: card UI lifecycle, display and fresh-install compatibility fixes.

- Discard queued actions from retired worlds/old Lua instances, select the local host/guest controller, and rebuild F7 after context changes.
- Preserve same-world description restoration during possession gaps and retire beta.4 active state safely.
- Keep F7 button captions single-line with native ellipsis and adapt pagination to viewport/DPI.
- Retain beta.4 conditional bonuses, compact descriptions, weapon applicability and complete F7 rules.
- Include the game-specific ProcessLocalScriptFunction signature, MIT attribution and bilingual installation/compatibility notes.

**Install:** fully exit the game, install official UE4SS separately, and copy this runtime ZIP's GameRoot into the game directory. Install the framework and included game signature **before the first launch**. Preserve existing loader DLLs/configuration and player Data. After travel, reopen F7.

**Validation:** 30 standalone Lua scripts and 27,600 card-description scenarios passed; archive CRC, privacy/allowlist and exact approved SHA-256 checks passed. Host/guest tests use synthetic engine boundaries. Node extraction to Chinese/space paths is verified; universal Windows narrow-fopen codepage behavior is not. Actual multiplayer/pixel acceptance, B07/B08 native-crash causation and 1183 native ABI remain unverified.

卡牌界面生命周期与排版更新。包含beta.4既有规则修正；修复旧世界回调、角色切换与旧版重载边界，F7列表单行并按视口/DPI分页。请先安装官方框架和随包游戏签名，再首次启动。旧版本继续保留回退。公开附件仅含本卡牌组件、必要依赖和说明，不包含存档、日志、原始转储、玩家数据或其他组件包。
